class.name: FellowWorldStreamer3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: keeps the [FellowStreamingCell3D] nodes below it loaded around the camera.
class.description: Every frame the streamer measures the distance from the viewport's camera (with [member use_camera]), its [member targets] and the [method prefetch] points to each cell's box. Cells within their load distance are requested from the [ResourceLoader]'s threads (the nearest first, at most [member max_loading] loading or being instantiated at once), instantiated on a worker thread ([member threaded_instancing]) and added to the tree, at most [member max_activations_per_frame] a frame; loaded cells beyond the distance plus [member unload_margin] are freed, the farthest first, at most [member max_releases_per_frame] a frame. With [member streaming] off every cell loads (the whole level resident). With FellowEngine's texture streaming ([code]rendering/fellow/streaming/textures[/code]) the cells' textures load with only their small mips. Proxies baked offline ([method bake_proxies]) stand in for the cells that are not loaded, and a cell's large meshes can be streamed by distance ([member mesh_distance]). See [code]docs/decisions/0147-world-streaming.md[/code] and [code]docs/decisions/0174-cell-proxies.md[/code].

method.name: bake_proxies
method.description: Bakes a proxy for each cell below the streamer: its scene's meshes, [MultiMeshInstance3D] instances (up to 256 a node) and [FellowTerrain3D] regions ([method FellowTerrain3D.make_proxy_arrays]) merged and simplified into one mesh whose vertex colours are its materials' albedo (a texture's mean colour times the material's colour), saved in [param directory] ([code]<cell>_proxy.res[/code], with one shared [code]fellow_proxy_material.tres[/code]) and added to the cell as a [MeshInstance3D] child named [code]FellowProxy[/code], shown while the cell is not loaded and hidden while it is. A proxy baked again replaces the cell's earlier one. [code]options["ratio"][/code] (0.05) is the share of the meshes' triangles kept, [code]options["terrain_quads"][/code] (32) the quads along a terrain region's side, [code]options["proxy_distance"][/code] (0: always) the distance beyond which a proxy is not drawn either, [code]options["proxy_shadows"][/code] ([code]false[/code]) whether proxies cast shadows, [code]options["owner"][/code] the proxies' owner (the streamer's owner by default, so that the editor saves them with the scene). With [code]options["stream_meshes"][/code] ([code]true[/code]), the cells' meshes of at least [code]options["mesh_min_triangles"][/code] (2000) triangles are also streamed: each is replaced in the cell's scene by a simplified stand-in ([code]options["mesh_ratio"][/code], 0.15, of its triangles, its materials kept), the full mesh saved apart ([code]meshes/<cell>_<n>.res[/code], unless it is a file of its own already), the cell's scene saved again into [param directory] and the cell's [member FellowStreamingCell3D.scene_path] changed to it; once loaded, the stand-ins take their full meshes within [member mesh_distance]. Returns [code]cells[/code], [code]proxies[/code], [code]source_triangles[/code], [code]proxy_triangles[/code], [code]streamed_meshes[/code], [code]streamed_triangles[/code], [code]stand_in_triangles[/code] and [code]bake_ms[/code]. The editor's [b]Project > Tools > Bake Streaming Proxies[/b] calls it on the selected streamer. See [code]docs/decisions/0174-cell-proxies.md[/code].

method.name: get_stats
method.description: The cells by state, loads and releases, failures, the main thread's time adding and removing cells (total and the largest), the worker threads' instantiation time, the time from request to the tree (total and the largest), the streamer's own time (total, the largest, and by step: [code]update_instanced_usec[/code] for instanced content taken or dropped, [code]update_meshes_usec[/code] for the streamed meshes, [code]update_loaded_usec[/code] for the distances and the loads that ended, [code]update_requests_usec[/code] for the loads requested), frames, [code]settled[/code]; the streamed meshes of the loaded cells ([code]streamed_meshes[/code], [code]streamed_meshes_full[/code]: those with their full mesh), their loads and releases ([code]mesh_loads[/code], [code]mesh_releases[/code]) and the main thread's time swapping meshes ([code]mesh_swap_usec[/code], [code]mesh_swap_usec_max[/code]).

method.name: is_settled
method.description: Every cell within its distance is in the tree, every cell beyond its distance plus the margin is freed, and nothing is loading.

method.name: load_now
method.description: Loads, instantiates and adds every cell in range at once, on this thread (behind a loading screen); returns how many entered the tree.

method.name: prefetch
method.description: Cells within [param radius] of [param position] (and within the load distance of it) load as if a camera were there: a teleport's destination, before the camera arrives.

method.name: split_into_cells
method.description: Splits [param root]'s 3D children into cells of [param cell_size] metres on this streamer's XZ grid: each cell's nodes are moved into a new scene saved in [param directory] ([code]cell_X_Z.scn[/code]) and replaced by a [FellowStreamingCell3D] under this streamer, placed at the cell's centre with the nodes' bounds; the nodes keep their global transforms when the cell loads. Both nodes must be in the scene tree. Left where they are: nodes of the classes in [code]options["exclude_classes"][/code] (by default [Camera3D], [DirectionalLight3D], [WorldEnvironment] and the streamers and cells themselves) and nodes wider than [code]options["max_span"][/code] cells (2: terrain, large structures). [code]options["load_distance"][/code] sets the cells' load distance (0: the streamer's), [code]options["extension"][/code] the scenes' format ([code]"scn"[/code] or [code]"tscn"[/code]), [code]options["owner"][/code] the new cells' owner (the root's owner by default, so that the editor saves them with the scene). With [code]options["split_terrains"][/code] ([code]false[/code] by default), a [FellowTerrain3D] is split into regions of about [param cell_size] metres ([method FellowTerrain3D.split_into_regions]), each a cell of its own, and removed. Returns the cells made. The editor's [b]Project > Tools > Split into Streaming Cells[/b] calls it on the selected streamer's parent, splitting terrains.

members.member: In the editor, every [FellowStreamingCell3D] below the streamer shows its [member FellowStreamingCell3D.scene_path] as an internal child: not in the Scene dock, not saved with the level, and a click on it selects the cell. Off for a world too large to show whole. Nothing in a game.
The distance from a cell's box at which it loads (a cell's own [member FellowStreamingCell3D.load_distance] wins).
Cells added to the tree a frame (each costs the main thread its nodes' entering the tree).
Cells loading or being instantiated at once.
Streamed meshes loading at once (see [method bake_proxies]).

A loaded cell's streamed meshes (see [method bake_proxies]) are loaded on the [ResourceLoader]'s threads and take the place of their stand-ins within this distance of their boxes, and go back to their stand-ins, the full meshes freed, beyond it plus [member unload_margin]. 0: the full meshes whenever their cells are loaded.
Off: every cell loads, whatever the distance.
Nodes around which cells load, besides the camera (players, vehicles).
A loaded cell's nodes are created on a worker thread (off: on the main thread, when its load finishes).
Hysteresis: a cell is freed only beyond its load distance plus this.
The viewport's current camera is a point around which cells load.
